author: official
summary: Lets a visitor enter an amount and requests a checkout link from the connected backend.

attributes.name: data-guild-id
attributes.description: Seller the checkout link is created for.

attributes.name: data-api-base
attributes.description: Backend base serving the sponsor route; trimmed with trailing slashes removed, without scheme validation.

attributes.name: data-currency-symbol
attributes.description: Displayed symbol; defaults to the currency code.

attributes.name: data-default-amount
attributes.description: Initial amount when the URL has no amount.

attributes.name: data-min
attributes.description: Smallest accepted amount in major units. Read as a string and clamped in hundredths.

attributes.name: data-max
attributes.description: Largest accepted amount in major units. Read as a string and clamped in hundredths.

attributes.name: data-amount-param
attributes.description: URL query key used to prefill the amount.

attributes.name: data-error-label
attributes.default: Could not start that just now — try again.

attributes.name: data-not-activated-label
attributes.default: This site hasn't turned on payments yet.
attributes.description: Message for a site without collection activated.

attributes.name: data-unconnected-label
attributes.default: Sponsoring is not set up on this site yet.
attributes.description: Message for a site without a connected payment account.
